impacts.reason: Theft of all router-held ETH/ERC-20 requires the router to hold balances and an attacker to craft aggregate3Value subcalls spending them; explicit intents state public callers must not spend router balances and dangerous entrypoints must be delegatecall-only.
Cross-user drain requires funds left on the router and an attacker crafting aggregate3Value subcalls; the explicit intent that public callers must not spend router-held balances directly applies.
